title: Dexcom G7 15 day sensor, backfill not working.
body:
I'm on the new Dexcom G7 15 day sensor. xDrip nightly build works with the sensors and can receive data. Warmup worked perfectly as well. 

I tried using the official dexcom app and it does backfill data correctly. I can provide logs or other data as needed. Navid Fo did send me a test app, but I have not installed it yet. I use xDrip with AAPS for looping.

_Originally posted by @billymild in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/4417_

comments.body: I think this should be resolved in today's nightly. Please test and let me know. Thanks.
